summary: Stiff and easy to print. Snaps tolerate about 1 to 2 % strain. Softens at about 55 °C.
clearance_note: the 3d-print-design defaults; replace them with values measured on your printer (processed/fits-PLA.json)
slicer: elephant foot narrows bed-side holes and grooves
outer walls 40 mm/s, inner 60 mm/s, infill 80 mm/s
slow outer walls keep the fits true
PLA needs full cooling for overhangs and bridges
notes: Dry the filament if it pops or strings (50 °C for 4–6 h).
Do not leave PLA parts in a hot car or in direct sun: they soften and creep.
